titulo: Amanat Ka Imtihan | Islamic Moral Story for Kids in Urdu | 3D Animation
descripcion:
A beautiful Islamic Moral Story for Kids in Urdu about honesty, Amanah, kindness and trust in Allah. ❤️

Watch this emotional 3D animated Islamic story, "Amanat Ka Imtihan", in which two little Muslim girls, Ayesha and Infa, discover a lost wallet containing money and an important medicine receipt.

They face a difficult decision: Should they keep the money or return the wallet to its rightful owner?

As the story unfolds, they discover that the money belongs to an elderly man who desperately needs it to buy medicine for his wife.

Will Ayesha and Infa return the lost wallet? What will they learn about honesty and Amanah?

Watch till the end to discover a beautiful Islamic lesson!

🌙 **LESSONS FROM THIS STORY:**

✅ Always return things that belong to others.
✅ Never take someone else's money.
✅ Always speak the truth.
✅ Help people who are in need.
✅ Remember that Allah knows everything we do.
✅ Do good deeds for the sake of Allah.

📖 **ISLAMIC MESSAGE:**

Amanah (trust) and honesty are important Islamic values. A good Muslim should always respect other people's belongings and fulfil their responsibilities.
